name: Mountain Azalea
desc: Mountain Azalea (Rhododendron canescens): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 16 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Rhododendron canescens, the piedmont azalea or mountain azalea, or wild azalea, or native azalea, or dead man’s handkerchief is a pink-blooming azalea native to the Eastern United States. R.
